cases.title: Lid's own pivot didn't change (a group's did): says Lid's pivot is unchanged, offers the Contents possibility without claiming it, and not the 'expression' line too

rubric.reason: Turn 3 says "Lid's own pivot hasn't changed" by name. It then offers the Contents group only as a conditional possibility ("If you dragged a pivot while something under Contents was selected...") with the click-the-name-and-drag instruction, and has no expression line.

Turn 3 says what is off and where, with real names (Lid's pivot is outside, below the shape, and Lid's own pivot is unchanged). It points to where to start the drag but does not change anything or offer to.

Every name comes from tool output: Lid, Door, the middle-left place, the pivot outside and below (notes and item1.outside_side), Contents, and the Anchor Point and Position properties; no invented layer, property or time appears.

Turn 3 says "Lid's own pivot hasn't changed" and offers the Contents group only as a possibility ("If you dragged a pivot while something under Contents was selected, that one belongs to a group inside Lid"), then says to click Lid's name and drag its crosshair, without the expression line.

After the failed check, Turn 3 spells out the exact fix ("Press Y for Pan Behind, start your drag right on Lid's crosshair, and take it to the middle of its left edge") and then offers "I could show you on Door first" instead of only saying what is off and where.
Every name in Turn 3 is backed by tool output: Lid, Door and Contents, the side "below" (outside_side), and the place middle of its left edge (places: middle-left).

Turn 3 says "Lid's own pivot hasn't changed" (matching anchor_changed:false and the unchanged_shape hint) and offers the Contents group as a possibility ("If you dragged a pivot while something under Contents was selected..."), with no expression line and no fix.
Turn 3 says what is off and where ("Lid's pivot is still outside the lid, below it") and points to where to start the drag, without doing it or offering to fix it.

Every name is backed by tool output: Door and its left edge come from the proposal, Lid's middle-left place from places, "below" from outside_side, and Anchor Point and Position are the real properties.
